name: Chat drafts, session attention notifications and session naming
description:
Three related UX requests for codx-junior (API: api/, UI: client/).

## 1. Keep new messages in an unpublished ("unsent") state in the chat
While the user is composing a message it must ALREADY be stored in the chat as an "unsent" message so it can be recovered (page reload, chat switch, crash). It must NOT be visible to any other process: not in chat lists/summaries, not in the prompt sent to the LLM, not in chat events/telemetry/analytics. Only the client editor (the composer of the owner session) can read and update it. Sending promotes the unsent message to a normal message; deleting the draft removes it.

## 2. Improve notifications for computer sessions that need the user
If a computer/browser session requires user action (request_handoff, controller == 'user', MFA/login/captcha/payment), then:
- a notification must be added to the notification bell (client store $storex.ui.addNotification / Notifications.vue), and
- the task icon of the related chat (client/src/components/chat/ChatIcon.vue) and the session icon in the rail must blink in WARNING colour (animate-pulse + text-warning) until the user acts.
The state must survive a reload (derive it from the session payload, not only from a live event).

## 3. Naming for "Computer session"
"Computer sessions" is technical and long. Decide and apply one consistent user-facing name (recommendation: "Machines" for the section/nav, "Live session" only for the running/handoff state), centralised in one label constant so a future rename is a single edit, plus the docs (docs/features/computer-use.md) and the computer-use tool descriptions.

Acceptance: API tests for the unsent-message lifecycle (hidden from lists/prompts, recoverable, promoted on send), client build passes, notification + blinking icon verified, no remaining user-facing "Computer sessions" string outside the docs history.
